label: Source of an existence reason: the being a reason token is about, by its nature or as a circumstance
definition: For a #312 reason token, its source is the bearer of an intrinsic token (that being's own nature) or the being of a circumstantial token. reasonModel F explains puts #312 reason tokens on the causality frame's own world-relative existence, adding only the reason relation. The source is the being a reason is about; nothing makes it a cause, existent, concrete or adequate.
note: Analyst formulation for the B2 brute-contingency and parity batch (owner direction 2026-11-23); attribution deferred. See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md, 'Brute contingency and parity'.
